# Motion dependency

Locally served GSAP 3.14.2, reused from the workspace's Day-01 distribution.

- Original distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- Original copyright and license header preserved in gsap.min.js.

GSAP smooths the ingredient orbit and coordinates the cup crossfade. Selection,
native scrolling, cart controls, and reduced-motion behavior work without it.
